data.one_liner: Pre-built voice and video calling UI components and low-code integration.
data.what_it_does: ZegoUIKit offers low-code, pre-built, and UI-ready components like AudioVideoView and CameraButtons. It helps developers quickly assemble voice and video calling features into their applications with minimal code.
use_when: You need to quickly implement voice and video calling features using pre-built UI components.
You want a low-code approach for audio/video streaming integration.
avoid_when: You require fully custom-designed video rendering interfaces that cannot be achieved with pre-built components.
Your app does not involve audio or video communication features.
strengths: Pre-built UI-ready components save substantial development time.
Supports voice and video calls with just a few lines of code.
weaknesses: Heavy reliance on a proprietary third-party engine and ecosystem.
May offer less design flexibility compared to building entirely custom UI over a raw engine.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform configuration for iOS and Android, including permissions for camera and microphone.
data.minimal_example: UI Kit is a full-featured voice + video component, which enables calls with just a few lines of code.
